newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm-up $1 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market firm-up $1 - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers firm to $1.00 per cwt higher on a live basis, compared with Monday's close, USDA said.
Trade light. Demand moderate. Seller interest light. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1300 lb 71.00-72.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lb 71.00-72.00 2 ld 72.50.
Carcass basis (weight only), slaughter steers and heifers were steady to $1.00 higher in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 113.00-114.00 2 ld 115.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select to mostly Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 107.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 101.00.
